segment_contamination_dimensions: FRP-material-specific security cabin buyers are carved out by sibling MCAT 'FRP Portable Security Cabin' (ID 145135) — names must not be exclusively FRP-material-positioned (e.g., 'FRP Security Cabin' as a standalone name is blocked; multi-material names that include FRP alongside other materials are permitted)

MS-material-specific security cabin buyers are carved out by sibling MCAT 'MS Security Cabins' (ID 150853) — names must not be exclusively MS-material-positioned (e.g., 'MS Security Cabin' as a standalone name is blocked)

Prefabricated-label-only security cabin buyers are carved out by sibling MCAT 'Prefabricated Security Cabin' (ID 181975) — names must not be exclusively 'prefabricated security cabin' without the portable/relocatable differentiator

General non-security portable cabin buyers are served by sibling MCATs 'Portable Cabin' (ID 35400), 'Modular Portable Cabin' (ID 165827), and 'Prefabricated Cabin' (ID 135712) — names must retain the security/guard/watchman qualifier to avoid attracting general portable cabin buyers
Toll booth buyers are carved out by sibling MCAT 'Toll Booth' (ID 135797) — names must not be toll-booth-positioned (toll, toll plaza booth as primary descriptor is blocked)
Frisking booth buyers are carved out by sibling MCAT 'Frisking Booth' (ID 207959) — names must not be frisking-booth-positioned
